judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8070, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025, which set defense policy, raised junior enlisted pay, and authorized Department of Defense programs and military construction. It passed the House 217-199.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8070, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025, which set defense policy, raised junior enlisted pay, and authorized Department of Defense programs and military construction. It passed the House 217-199.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7637, the Refrigerator Freedom Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting efficiency standards for refrigerators and freezers unless it could show the standards were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 212-192.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7637, the Refrigerator Freedom Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting efficiency standards for refrigerators and freezers unless it could show the standards were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 212-192.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7700, the Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting dishwasher efficiency standards unless it could show they were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 214-192.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7700, the Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting dishwasher efficiency standards unless it could show they were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 214-192.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8281, the SAVE Act, which required documentary proof of United States citizenship, such as a passport or birth certificate, to register to vote in federal elections. It passed the House 221-198.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8281, the SAVE Act, which required documentary proof of United States citizenship, such as a passport or birth certificate, to register to vote in federal elections. It passed the House 221-198.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 165, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Education Department's 2024 Title IX rule extending sex discrimination protections to gender identity and sexual orientation. It passed the House 210-205.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 165, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Education Department's 2024 Title IX rule extending sex discrimination protections to gender identity and sexual orientation. It passed the House 210-205.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8314, the No Foreign Election Interference Act, which barred tax-exempt organizations that accept money from foreign nationals from giving to political committees for eight years. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 218-181.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8314, the No Foreign Election Interference Act, which barred tax-exempt organizations that accept money from foreign nationals from giving to political committees for eight years. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 218-181.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7909, the Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act, which made immigrants inadmissible or deportable for stalking, child abuse, sex offenses, domestic violence, or violating a protection order. It passed the House 266-158.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7909, the Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act, which made immigrants inadmissible or deportable for stalking, child abuse, sex offenses, domestic violence, or violating a protection order. It passed the House 266-158.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 5717, the No Bailout for Sanctuary Cities Act, which cut off federal funds that a state or locality intended to spend on services for immigrants without lawful status. It passed the House 219-186.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 5717, the No Bailout for Sanctuary Cities Act, which cut off federal funds that a state or locality intended to spend on services for immigrants without lawful status. It passed the House 219-186.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 136, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the EPA multi-pollutant tailpipe standards for model year 2027 and later light and medium duty vehicles. It passed the House 215-191.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 136, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the EPA multi-pollutant tailpipe standards for model year 2027 and later light and medium duty vehicles. It passed the House 215-191.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8790, the Fix Our Forests Act, which designated high-risk firesheds for federal wildfire work while exempting many forest management projects from environmental review and limiting court challenges to them. It passed the House 268-151.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8790, the Fix Our Forests Act, which designated high-risk firesheds for federal wildfire work while exempting many forest management projects from environmental review and limiting court challenges to them. It passed the House 268-151.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7673, the Liberty in Laundry Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting clothes washer efficiency standards unless it could show they were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 215-200.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7673, the Liberty in Laundry Act, which barred the Department of Energy from setting clothes washer efficiency standards unless it could show they were affordable and would not reduce performance. It passed the House 215-200.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 82, the Social Security Fairness Act, which repealed the windfall elimination provision and the government pension offset, restoring full Social Security benefits to public employees with government pensions. It passed the Senate 76-20 and was signed into law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 82, the Social Security Fairness Act, which repealed the windfall elimination provision and the government pension offset, restoring full Social Security benefits to public employees with government pensions. It passed the Senate 76-20 and was signed into law.
